Let me think this through.

Board: 4♠, A♦, A♥ – two-broadway board  
Hand: 3♠, 6♥ – offsuit 3-high, absolute nothing.  

Both opponents have already agreed to a tiny pre-flop pot (only 20 each), so they almost certainly don’t have monster hands either. The flop just hit them with an A-A, but if any of them actually held an Ace they’d likely bet now. Since they didn’t, the field is wide open.

With 980 chips behind, risking anything with 3-high would be crazy. Best to keep the pot small and see if a cheap turn/river can help (though two more 3s or a running straight draw would still be weak).  

I’m just going to check here, hope everyone else does the same, and maybe see a free card.

[Check]
